collection.title: Audi S6 Avant 2012 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi S6 Avant 2012 to 2018 model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers and a 221" wiper blade for the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
